recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future Device module or DeviceDefinition narrative improvements should be handled through their own Jira issues rather than reopening FHIR-49453.
issue_request: FHIR-49453 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. The original comment said DeviceDefinition had an empty Background and Context section and inadequate Boundaries and Relationships text; the final resolution was to remove Background and Context and update Boundaries and Relationships while moving common device-resource relationship explanations into the Device module page.

FHIR-40288 commits faf0e6f2ead30cb289377f4ddc89a2e368440cbd and 6821c4b5c5236f06e179ec1d956c5514b90a807e had already added and corrected the Device module page.

reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/devicedefinition/devicedefinition-introduction.xml has no Background and Context anchor or heading, and its Boundaries and Relationships section now explains DeviceDefinition versus Device, references from other resources, and medication/substance/biologically-derived/nutrition jurisdictional boundaries. Current source/device-module.html contains module-level context, resource relationships, and common use cases.
